name: Inter 3, dynamic metrics (Rasmus Andersson)
formula: tracking = a + b × e^(c × z), z = font size
units: Not stated in the page's text. Its script writes the result as letter-spacing in em at a font-size in px (the archived page, lines 431-432 and 443-444).
source: https://d.rsms.me/inter-website/v3/dynmetrics/ (archived copy of the Inter 3 website; read 30 October 2026)
live_page: https://rsms.me/inter/dynmetrics/ returned a 'no longer exists' page on 30 October 2026, pointing to the archived copy above
hand_set_values: The page compares the formula with tracking values 'designed one by one, by hand' (line 201) and shows each size's distance from them (line 101). The set dated 2019-02-07, the date on the constants (line 327), runs from +0.043em at 6px to 0 at 12px and -0.022em at 40px and 80px (lines 295-313).
line_height: The page says it calculates the line height as well as the tracking (lines 64-66). Its script sets line height = round(1.4 x font size) (lines 330 and 347-349); the formula line for it is commented out of the page's text (lines 75-77).
